versions.changelog: Documents analyst coverage: which symbols answer (tracked US-listed stocks and ADRs), what each 404 code means for unknown symbols, non-US listings, ETFs and indexes, and how to tell the user a symbol has no coverage instead of retrying.
The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Initiations carry no prior grade, reiterations are filtered out by default, free previews are partial slices, and the coverage, consensus history and earnings reaction notes are corrected.
Two workflows: Consensus drift over the new consensus/history endpoint, and Who called it over the new called-it endpoint; carried-count guidance
Adds a scoped handoff to the earnings skill for what a company actually reported, kept separate from the Street reaction; removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.
Names the coverage container in the response.

Consensus counts documented as a broker survey panel revised in batches through the month (customer-measured), with the fetch-gap note: an all-zero distribution next to a populated recommendationMean is a fetch gap, not an empty panel. Unknown symbols now answer entity_not_found with suggestions and tracked symbols without a record answer no_coverage, so the wrong-symbol guidance is updated. Convergence workflow: holders no longer needs a reportDate.

CLI-first on the coverage and analyst-record workflows, on sentisense CLI 0.52.0: analysts <ticker> --coverage prints the whole-book Buy/Hold/Sell/Unrated counts and one row per firm with the named analyst and slug; analyst <slug> --calls prints one analyst's firms, coverage book and call history; search <name> --type company resolves a company name to its symbol before any analyst call. REST paths unchanged and still documented in full. CLI pin 0.52.0.

Names the X-SentiSense-API-Key header under Prerequisites. Crowd-metric series documented as bare arrays (no envelope). Reaction insight described by its real fields: counts live in insightText. New notes: a wrong symbol returns an empty book with 200 while consensus returns 404, so resolve names first; consensus counts are a month-keyed survey panel, never a tally of the actions feed. Convergence workflow carries its four REST calls inline. Post-print fallback no longer claims target direction from a coverage row. CLI line passes --days 30.

First release: who covers a stock with whole-book Buy/Hold/Sell counts, upgrades and downgrades by ticker and market-wide with reiterations filtered, one analyst's profile and call history, Street versus crowd against the SentiSense Score and Sentiment, and which firms moved in the five sessions after an earnings print. CLI pinned to sentisense 0.51.0.
